reason_manual: Hetzner publishes no public pricing API, and hetzner.com/cloud renders its price table client-side, so an HTTP fetch returns no figures. These rows are transcribed by hand from the primary source below and re-checked on each verified_date.
vat_note: The source page states verbatim that all prices exclude VAT.
notes: Effective 15 June 2026 Hetzner both raised prices and rotated plan generations.

CX Gen2 (CX22/CX32/CX42) and CPX Gen1 (CPX11-CPX51) are deprecated and can no longer be created in the Cloud Console. CPX Gen1 survives only in the USA (ASH/HIL) price table, which is not covered here.
Existing servers keep their previous price until they are rescaled.
The often-repeated '+30%' summary only holds for CX and CAX. CPX and CCX more than doubled in DE/FI.

CPX12 is deliberately absent: it does not appear in the price-adjustment table, and that table lists only products whose price changed, so its absence is not evidence of a figure. No price is published here rather than guessing one.
